en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small settlement with wooden houses and a prominent large white church-like building with a tower on the right. In the foreground is an open grassy field; behind it run a road and telephone poles. Trees and additional houses are visible in the background under a cloudy sky. Text identifying the place appears at the bottom left, and a small logo of the photographer/printer appears at the bottom right.
